BackstoryDef.title: Hive creche broodling
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in a communal Wraith creche where feeding discipline, silence and obedience to older castes shaped every early lesson.

BackstoryDef.title: Living-ship broodling
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood inside a living vessel, learning its moods, passages and organic machinery almost as naturally as walking.

BackstoryDef.title: Feeding-court ward
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among feeding courts and guarded holding chambers, learning early how hierarchy, restraint and hunger shaped Wraith society.

BackstoryDef.title: Archive-born template
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s earliest memories were assembled from archived developmental patterns, with education arriving as carefully curated experiences rather than an ordinary childhood.

BackstoryDef.title: Constructed service pattern
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was initialized around a practical service template, learning maintenance, observation and cooperation through repeated simulated assignments.

BackstoryDef.title: Recovered biological imprint
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s formative identity was reconstructed from a damaged biological pattern archive. Some memories are vivid, others only impressions retained by the nanite lattice.

BackstoryDef.title: Prey trail hunter
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to follow frightened prey through broken terrain, reading movement and hesitation before closing for capture.

BackstoryDef.title: Culling runner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] served in fast-moving culling parties, learning to isolate useful captives without wasting the feeding stock a Hive needed.

BackstoryDef.title: Hive boarder
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] fought in close corridors and breached settlements where hesitation meant starvation for the warriors behind [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: Brood line warrior
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years holding the hard center of Wraith assaults, protecting commanders and keeping younger hunters from breaking formation.

BackstoryDef.title: Raid coordinator
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] coordinated hunters, warriors and craft crews during raids, balancing captives, casualties and the temper of [PAWN_possessive] Queen.

BackstoryDef.title: Territory commander
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] managed distant hunting grounds and rival-lineage boundaries, learning when intimidation was cheaper than open conflict.

BackstoryDef.title: Dormancy keeper
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] maintained hibernating Wraith and the living systems around them, waking only those the Hive could feed and sustain.

BackstoryDef.title: Feeding reserve keeper
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] supervised feeding reserves and biological infrastructure, preserving both captives and Wraith through long shortages.

BackstoryDef.title: Brood matriarch
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] shaped a Wraith brood through command, bargaining and ruthless decisions over territory, feeding and survival.

BackstoryDef.title: Hive court ruler
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] ruled through a court of commanders and keepers, learning to turn rivalry into obedience without wasting valuable lives.

BackstoryDef.title: Hive defector
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] abandoned [PAWN_possessive] former Hive after refusing its demands, carrying Wraith instincts into a life shaped by new loyalties.

BackstoryDef.title: Long exile
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] survived away from Wraith society long enough to learn restraint, barter and the difficult habits of coexistence.

BackstoryDef.title: Nanite fabricator
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] maintained fabrication lattices and learned to diagnose failures by watching how matter moved through a machine network.

BackstoryDef.title: Pattern reconstructor
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] specialized in rebuilding damaged systems from incomplete patterns, treating missing information as an engineering problem.

BackstoryDef.title: Lattice sentinel
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] guarded synthetic facilities against biological raiders and machine incursions, learning disciplined ranged combat.

BackstoryDef.title: Interdiction unit
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] served in precision strike teams tasked with disabling dangerous targets before they could damage the wider collective.

BackstoryDef.title: Consensus coordinator
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] translated collective priorities into orders that individual units could execute without losing local initiative.

BackstoryDef.title: Lattice strategist
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] modeled hostile settlements, supply lines and machine behavior, then converted those models into precise collective action.

BackstoryDef.title: Biological observer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years studying biological societies at close range, learning their routines well enough to move among them without constant direction.

BackstoryDef.title: Pattern mediator
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] worked between isolated synthetic groups, reconciling divergent memories and priorities before they became open conflict.

BackstoryDef.title: Sleeper-pattern operative
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] rehearsed ordinary biological habits until conversation, hesitation and error could be performed without conscious calculation.

BackstoryDef.title: Identity mimic
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] specialized in reconstructing accents, routines and social expectations from fragments of observed behavior.

BackstoryDef.title: Independent pattern
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] separated from collective command and learned to make decisions for a small community rather than a distributed network.

BackstoryDef.title: Recovered synthetic
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] survived the collapse of a former network and rebuilt [PAWN_possessive] identity around the people who recovered [PAWN_objective].
